referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A fixed dark sidebar carries a portrait, name, role, icon navigation, and social links. The main field opens with a blurred landscape photograph behind a centered light statement, a supporting line, and a teal button. A portfolio grid follows, then an about section and contact forms. The type is a light humanist sans. Charcoal sidebar, muted landscape photography, white content, and a muted teal action create an editorial portfolio tone.
